mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_folder (user_id, parent_id, name, create_time, update_time, deleted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, NOW(), NOW(), NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted_at = NULL, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE permission_check AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM user_folder WHERE id = #{targetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id, f.parent_id FROM user_folder f INNER JOIN permission_check pc ON f.id = pc.parent_id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND pc.id != #{rootId} AND pc.parent_id != 0 ) SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM permission_check WHERE id = #{rootId} )

WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS (
SELECT id, parent_id FROM user_folder WHERE id = #{rootId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT f.id, f.parent_id FROM user_folder f INNER JOIN folder_tree ft ON f.parent_id = ft.id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL ),
valid_folder_ids AS ( SELECT id FROM folder_tree ),
valid_file_ids AS ( SELECT f.id FROM user_file f WHERE f.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_folder_ids) AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ),
input_items AS (
SELECT #{item.id} AS id, #{item.type} AS type
)
SELECT DISTINCT input.id, input.type FROM input_items input WHERE (input.type = 0 AND input.id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_folder_ids)) OR (input.type = 1 AND input.id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_file_ids))
